technical_requirements: Primary workload: inline completions and multi-line suggestions in IDE tabs
TTFT (time-to-first-token) target: 40-80ms for single-line inline suggestions; <=120ms acceptable for larger blocks
Jitter target: median jitter <15ms; 95th percentile jitter <40ms
Throughput: expects 1500 concurrent active dev sessions at peak across org
Token budget policy: per-suggestion budget default 32 tokens, dynamic budget for code blocks up to 128 with cost caps
Backpressure strategy: client-side token-budget enforcement + server-side early-stop fallback to short-mode; support for cancel tokens
Model/version pinning: must be able to pin dev channel to specific model build for rollback and A/B within workspace
Streaming behavior: required streaming-first responses (TTFT) with incremental edits rather than bulk final payloads
Batching: want batching across background L2 queue but not introduce perceived latency to active tab
Cache reuse: KV cache reuse across repeated completions and local heuristic to avoid regenerating tokens
Quantization preference: 8-bit-friendly model variants acceptable if latency gains >20% and quality regression <2%
